title: Metabolomics RDF Resource
description: Metadata describing one RDF dataset or SPARQL endpoint relevant to metabolomics and its cartography status.

namespace.description: Primary RDF namespace or vocabulary URI, if known.

description.description: What the resource covers and why it's relevant to metabolomics.

group.description: Name of the collection the dataset belongs to, if applicable, e.g. 'RDF Portal', 'FORVM', 'EBI RDF Platform'.

keywords.description: Topic terms from the Biolink Model vocabulary (https://biolink.github.io/biolink-model/), e.g. 'biolink:SmallMolecule', 'biolink:Pathway', 'biolink:Publication'. Use the closest matching Biolink class/category for each topic covered.

taxonomic_scope.description: Organism(s) covered, as NCBI Taxonomy IDs (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy), e.g. 'NCBITaxon:9606' (human), 'NCBITaxon:4932' (yeast). Use 'NCBITaxon:1' for root/pan-species/not organism-specific.

endpoint_available.description: Whether a live SPARQL/RDF query endpoint exists for this resource.

endpoint_url.description: The SPARQL/RDF query endpoint URL. Required when endpoint_available is true.

dump_available.description: Whether a downloadable RDF dump/export exists for this resource.

dump_url.description: URL to download an RDF dump/export. Required when dump_available is true.

size.description: Order-of-magnitude size by triple count, not a precise figure. XS: <10K, S: 10K-100K, M: 100K-1M, L: 1M-100M, XL: >100M. See README for details.

supports_federation.description: Whether the endpoint is known to tolerate being queried via SPARQL SERVICE from other endpoints (federated queries).

example_query.description: A short SPARQL query known to work against this endpoint.

contact.description: Email or handle of a maintainer/contact for the resource itself (not the person submitting this entry).

license.description: License or usage terms for the data, e.g. 'CC0', 'CC-BY 4.0', 'unspecified'.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the paper or resource to cite when using this dataset, in bare form (e.g. '10.1093/nar/gkab1104'), without a URL prefix.

date_submitted.description: Date this entry was first added.

date_last_update.description: Date this entry's metadata was last updated.

charted.description: Whether the resource has been processed by the private cartography workflow and included in the federation map.

map_rdf.description: URL to download the dataset's quotient in RDF, when published.

map_view.description: URL to visualize the dataset's quotient map, when published.

availability.description: Operational status maintained by the consortium. Not set by the requester and not automatically probed by repository CI.
